name: Light My Fire
source:
A real emotional roller-coaster is ahead of you! Are you ready to discover other people's secrets, while trying to hide your own? Remember, some mistakes, although tempting, are not worth making twice!

[From in-app]
translation:
一场真正的情感过山车就在你面前！你准备好发现别人的秘密，同时试图隐藏自己的秘密了吗？请记住，有些错误虽然很诱人，但不值得犯两次！

[来自应用程序内]
